plan.summary: BRO-3573: clear 16 stale ambiguous-production wrongProduction flags, hand-adjudicated. Sweep: 5,241 files have wrongProduction + 2000+ chars of text and no human/date basis; the stub-time shape the card describes is the ambiguous-production stamp (35 files). Re-running the routing signals on today's stored date/url: 19 now point at their own show; by reading each text, 16 are reviews of this production (cleared here) and 3 are genuinely another run (buena-vista nytimes 2023 url, cats chicagotribune and exeunt off-Broadway 2024 reviews), plus othello-west-end-2022/guardian (2025 Haymarket review), all left flagged. The other 16 still have no signal for their own show and stay flagged. (part 2 of 2)
